title: A Drop for the Ghost
premise: Financial-crimes investigator Xanthe Montrose has spent years laundering her own past behind impeccable ledgers and a packed go-bag, until a stranger named Corvo arrives claiming she once saved his life — a favor she has no memory of — and calls in repayment: help him extract a defecting money-launderer, Sable, from a Baltic port before a dawn flight. As Xanthe peels back the operation, she discovers Sable is bait in a trap set by the syndicate that raised her, and that the 'favor' is her estranged father's final gambit to pull her home before he dies. Choosing loyalty over the clean escape she's always planned, Xanthe flies the extraction herself, exposes the syndicate's ledger to prosecutors, and gains a found family — Corvo, Sable, and her father's dying truth — at the cost of the anonymous life she built.
about_author: Ansel Nystrom is the pen name of a former compliance analyst who spent a decade tracing shell companies across three continents before turning to fiction. They write thrillers from a coastal town where the fog rolls in early, and where, they insist, every clean number hides a dirty story.

chapters.title: The Go-Bag by the Door
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. We meet her double life: flawless investigator by day, woman with an escape plan by night. A routine audit of a charity foundation shows money too clean to be innocent. Emotional beat: controlled loneliness, the comfort of always being ready to run.

chapters.title: A Debt She Never Owed
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. A man called Corvo intercepts her after work, thanking her for saving his life in Riga — an event she cannot remember — and asks repayment: one extraction, one night's work. Emotional beat: vertigo, the ground of her identity tilting.

chapters.title: Ledger Ghosts
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV, with a brief Corvo section. She traces the 'favor' through old case files and finds her own signature on documents she never signed. Emotional beat: unease sharpening into obsession.

chapters.title: The Client in the Glass
chapters.summary: Corvo's POV. He briefs Xanthe on the target: Sable, a syndicate accountant defecting with the master ledger, extraction at dawn from a Baltic port. He withholds who's paying. Emotional beat: Corvo's guilt over the lie he's telling her.

chapters.title: Clean Money, Dirty Hands
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. She runs the syndicate's finances overnight and recognizes the laundering architecture — it's the one her father taught her as a child. Emotional beat: dread of recognition, the past knocking.

chapters.title: The Ferry to Ventspils
chapters.summary: Xanthe and Corvo's alternating POV. They travel under work cover, posing as auditors. Corvo tests her loyalty with half-truths; she catches one. Emotional beat: wary intimacy, two liars circling.

chapters.title: Sable in the Cold Room
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. Hiding in a fish-processing plant, Sable memorizes the ledger and watches the syndicate's hunters arrive in town. Emotional beat: terror braided with grim pride.

chapters.title: First Contact
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. The rendezvous nearly fails when syndicate watchers sweep the docks; Xanthe improvises, and Sable trusts her with a fragment of the ledger — her father's alias inside it. Emotional beat: shock, the trap's outline emerging.

chapters.title: The Bait Question
chapters.summary: Corvo and Xanthe argue. If Sable is bait, the extraction is a trap — but aborting means Sable dies and the ledger burns. Emotional beat: loyalty versus survival, the book's central fault line cracking open.

chapters.title: What the Ledger Says About Me
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Decoding the fragment, she finds her father didn't just work for the syndicate — he built its clean-money machine, and he's dying, buying one last move with her name. Emotional beat: grief and fury at inheritance.

chapters.title: The Safehouse Betrayal
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. A syndicate strike team hits the safehouse; Sable escapes through freezing water, losing the backup drive. Emotional beat: betrayal — someone inside gave them up.

chapters.title: The Mole in the Glass
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. She narrows the leak to Corvo's client and forces a confession: the client is her father, and Corvo was his courier, the 'saved life' a manufactured debt to move her. Emotional beat: rage, then a colder question — why did she want it to be true?

chapters.title: Conversations with a Dying Man
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. A smuggled video call: her father, oxygen mask, apologizing not for the trap but for teaching her to run instead of stand. He offers her the full ledger and a choice. Emotional beat: the found-family theme ignites — what she owes the living versus the dead.

chapters.title: Port of Ghosts
chapters.summary: Corvo's POV. Corvo chooses Xanthe over the client, burning his contract and revealing the syndicate's dawn counter-move: they own the extraction plane. Emotional beat: redemption, loyalty chosen freely at last.

chapters.title: The Long Night Before Dawn
chapters.summary: Xanthe, Corvo, and Sable's rotating POV. They improvise a new extraction — a fishing trawler, a forged manifest, Xanthe's clean-money skills turned into weapons. Emotional beat: the trio becoming a unit, a family under fire.

chapters.title: Hunters on the Quay
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. The syndicate closes in; Sable offers to surrender himself as decoy. Xanthe refuses — the first time she's refused to spend a person to save herself. Emotional beat: her transformation made explicit.

chapters.title: Dawn, and the Runway
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. The syndicate seizes the airstrip; the trawler plan dies. Xanthe flies the extraction herself in a chartered cargo plane she buys mid-flight with a forged wire transfer — her father's tradecraft, used against his masters. Emotional beat: exhiliration and terror, inheritance reclaimed.

chapters.title: Climax — The Ledger and the Gun
chapters.summary: Xanthe and Corvo's POV. Mid-air and on the ground, the syndicate's enforcer boards at a fuel stop. A standoff in the cargo hold; Sable's ledger becomes the only weapon that matters. Xanthe broadcasts the master ledger to prosecutors mid-standoff, making herself and Sable worthless as targets. Emotional beat: truth as the ultimate loyalty.

chapters.title: Landing
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. They land under prosecutor protection; the syndicate's network begins collapsing as the ledger goes public. Emotional beat: exhaustion, disbelief, the strange lightness of having stopped running.

chapters.title: The Inheritance
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Her father dies hours after the ledger lands, leaving her not money but a confession that clears her mother's name. Emotional beat: mourning entangled with release; inheritance redefined.

chapters.title: A Debt Repaid Differently
chapters.summary: Corvo's POV. Corvo formally dissolves the false debt and, instead, asks for something real: to stay in touch. Sable starts a new life testifying. Emotional beat: found family solidifying into ordinary, unglamorous bonds.

chapters.title: The Unpacked Bag
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Months later, Xanthe unpacks the go-bag for the first time in years — keeping one packed bag for Sable, who still can't sleep without an exit. Final beat: she has stopped running, but she keeps a door open for the family she chose.
